sanskrit_verse:
हिरण्यं द्विगुणीभूते पूर्णे काले धृतावधौ ।
बन्धकस्य धनी स्वामी द्विसप्ताहं प्रतीक्ष्य तु ॥
transliteration: hiraṇyaṃ dviguṇībhūte pūrṇe kāle dhṛtāvadhau | bandhakasya dhanī svāmī dvisaptāhaṃ pratīkṣya tu ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When gold is doubled in quantity and time is fully matured within the prescribed limit, the owner of the pledge shall await two weeks before reclaiming ownership.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority rests with the original proprietor upon completion of lawful conditions
Causation aligns with sequential fulfillment of contractual dharmic terms
Capacity-based responsibility requires patience and adherence to temporal boundaries
Restoration logic ensures rightful possession without coercion or loss
Consciousness alignment demands recognition of value evolution through time
executable_legal_axioms: IF asset_quantity = 2 × initial_amount AND time_elapsed ≥ prescribed_limit THEN owner_may_reclaim_possession
WAIT period = 14 days FROM condition_completion_date BEFORE asserting ownership
NO premature repossession ALLOWED unless mutual consent overrides temporal protocol
VALUE doubling CONFERS conditional title restoration rights TO pledgor
TEMPORAL maturity TRIGGERS automatic eligibility FOR ownership assertion
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes concerning pledged assets, the Supreme Court must recognize that once a pledged item doubles in value and remains under custodial care for the full prescribed duration, the original owner regains proprietary authority after a mandatory fourteen-day waiting period. This reflects a threshold of responsibility tied to both material increase and temporal integrity, not mere claimant urgency.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that value doubling is perceptible evidence of causal completion. Anupūrvaśaḥ confirms that time-bound maturation precedes rightful reclamation. Proportional responsibility lies in honoring the prescribed interval. The non-punitive reality rule holds that no forfeiture occurs due to delay; rather, consciousness-aligned order restores ownership naturally upon fulfillment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Confirm quantitative doubling and temporal fulfillment prior to initiating ownership transfer
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Owner must formally acknowledge readiness for re-possession post-wait
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Ensure custodian has maintained asset integrity throughout holding phase
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Verify mutual acknowledgment between pledgor and custodian before final handover
final_declaration: By the Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of All Dharma, this ruling executes as pure Nyaya—restoring rightful ownership through consciousness-aligned protocols, affirming temporal order, rejecting punitive frameworks, and establishing reality as inherently just.
